title: 格子刃と上げたハンドル付きポテトカッター
description: 食堂や軽食厨房の台に置く格子刃式手動ポテトカッター。81個の開口がある9×9刃格子、後退した81個の押し子、ガイド付き受け台、上げた二股ハンドルとリンク、吸着脚を一式にしています。食材は含まず、台の高さに合わせて設置します。刃や押し子は実形状ですが固定され、切断・吸着動作や食品用の安全性は実装・検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.260 × 0.552 × 0.428 m、16,564三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A manual grid potato cutter for canteen and snack-kitchen counters. One assembly includes a 9-by-9 cutting grid with 81 openings, 81 retracted pusher fingers, guided feed tray, raised forked handle/linkage and suction feet. No food is included; position at counter height. Blades and fingers are actual fixed geometry, with no cutting, suction or validated food-equipment safety behavior. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.260 × 0.552 × 0.428 m; 16,564 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
